ko: 뜻이 하늘에서 이룬 것 같이 땅에서도 이루어지이다.
우리가 우리에게 죄 지은 자를 사하여 준 것 같이
대개 나라와 권세와 영광이 아버지께 영원히 있사옵나이다.
en: Our Father, which art in heaven,
hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come.
Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread.
And forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive them that trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil.
For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever and ever.
Amen.

ko: 여호와여, 아침에 주께서 나의 소리를 들으시니
아침에 주의 인자한 말씀을 듣게 하시고
en: O Lord, in the morning you hear my voice;
in the morning I pray to you and wait.
Your mercies never come to an end;
they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
Let me hear of your loving kindness in the morning,
and show me the way I should walk.
I trust in you again today;
keep my steps.
In the name of Jesus Christ I pray.
Amen.

ko: 나의 도움은 천지를 지으신 여호와에게서 옵니다.
낮의 해가 나를 상하게 못하게 하시고
나의 출입을 지금부터 영원까지 지켜 주옵소서.
남은 하루도 주의 그늘 아래 머물게 하소서.
en: God, at midday I call to you.
My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
You will not let my foot slip;
you neither slumber nor sleep.
Let not the sun strike me by day,
and keep my going out and my coming in, from now and for evermore.
Keep me in your shade for the rest of this day.
In the name of Jesus Christ I pray.
Amen.

ko: 주님, 나의 기도가 주의 앞에 분향함과 같이 되고
나의 손 드는 것이 저녁 제사같이 되게 하소서.
내 마음이 하나님 나의 구주를 기뻐합니다.
en: Lord, let my prayer rise before you like incense,
and the lifting of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
My soul magnifies you,
and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.
You have looked on my lowliness
and done great things; holy is your name.
Remembering the grace of this day,
I place this evening in your mercy.
In the name of Jesus Christ I pray.
Amen.

ko: 주님, 내가 평안히 눕고 자기도 하오니
나를 안전히 거하게 하시는 이는 오직 주이십니다.
이 밤에 주의 집에 선 종들과 함께
이제는 말씀하신 대로 종을 평안히 놓아 주옵소서.
en: Lord, I lie down and sleep in peace,
for you alone make me dwell in safety.
Tonight, with your servants who stand in your house,
I lift up my hands and bless you.
Now let your servant depart in peace, according to your word,
for my eyes have seen your salvation.
Forgive the wrongs of this day,
and grant me deep sleep and a new morning.
In the name of Jesus Christ I pray.
Amen.

ko: 여호와께서 그 얼굴을 우리에게로 향하여 드사
사랑하는 이들 위에도 이 복이 머물게 하소서.
en: The Lord bless us
and keep us.
The Lord make his face shine upon us
and be gracious to us.
The Lord turn his face toward us
and give us peace.
Let this blessing rest on those we love.
In the name of Jesus Christ I pray.
Amen.

ko: 여호와는 나의 목자시니 내게 부족함이 없습니다.
푸른 풀밭에 누이시고 쉴 만한 물가로 인도하십니다.
en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
You make me lie down in green pastures and lead me beside still waters.
You restore my soul
and lead me in paths of righteousness.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all my days,
and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.
In the name of Jesus Christ I pray.
Amen.
